title: Hearty Silky Vietnamese Oat Porridge
description: A jammy and silky Vietnamese dish featuring porridge oats and kombu cold extract, perfect for a comforting breakfast
instructions: In a large pot, bring the water to a boil over high heat
Add the oats, kombu cold extract, and salt, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes
Stir in the coconut milk and cook for an additional 5 minutes
Add the sliced ginger and cook for 2 minutes
Use an immersion blender to puree the porridge until smooth
Alternatively, transfer the porridge to a blender and blend until smooth, then return it to the pot
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed
Serve the porridge hot, garnished with chopped scallions or other desired toppings
